claims.head: Forecheck against patience
claims.body: On forecheck pressure, Florida is the league’s best, but Pittsburgh is the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Expect the Panthers to win more pucks back deep in the Penguins’ end.

notes.text: Aleksander Barkov is on long-term injured reserve (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 8 games. He is one of their best players.
Brad Marchand is on injured reserve (leg injury) and has missed the last 6 games.
Trevor van Riemsdyk is day to day (lower body injury) and has missed the last 5 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters. Spencer Stastney has taken his spot beside Kris Letang.
Ben Kindel is on injured reserve, reported after he played in their last game. He is a top-six forward.
Bryan Rust is on injured reserve, reported after he played in their last game.
Egor Chinakhov returned in their last game after missing 2 games.
Ilya Solovyov was added to the roster on Oct 20.

PIT.head: The matchup suits the Penguins
PIT.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Florida is on the second night of a back-to-back and will be without Barkov, while Pittsburgh has home-ice advantage and gets Söderblom back. The Panthers’ way back in is a penalty kill that holds up.

FLA.head: Not an easy night for the Panthers
FLA.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Florida is on the second night of a back-to-back and will be without Barkov, while Pittsburgh has home-ice advantage and gets Söderblom back. The Panthers can pull it off if their penalty kill holds up.

story.head: The Penguins are searching for answers
paras: The Penguins are on a four-game losing streak. The Panthers are 5-3-2.

It’s strength against strength: the Penguins are one of the league’s best for chance quality, but the Panthers are near the top at preventing dangerous shots. The Panthers hound the puck, but the Pens sit back.
